title: 'It sets a bad precedent': Jim Harbaugh says Broncos used 'loophole' to base Daiyan Henley's physical on if Chargers would take less trade compensation

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'It sets a bad precedent': Jim Harbaugh says Broncos used 'loophole' to base Daiyan Henley's physical on if Chargers would take less trade compensation
sources.description: Harbaugh said Denver would have given the linebacker a passing medical grade if Los Angeles downgraded the second pick in the agreed-upon deal.
